items.definition:
the action of allowing someone to do something
You need permission to enter this area.

a person who is studying or has studied science
The scientist conducted an experiment.

custom, belief passed down
It's a family tradition to have a big dinner on Sundays.

a piece of furniture or a group of government ministers
She keeps her dishes in the kitchen cabinet.

a black mineral used as fuel
Coal is a fossil fuel used to generate electricity.

a room or building for displaying art
We visited an art gallery downtown.

the act of making something better
There has been a significant improvement in his health.

a feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction
He felt great pride in his daughter's achievements.

a quality of sound; a manner of speaking
Her tone of voice was very serious.

a car
He bought a new auto last month.

a rate, number, or amount in each hundred
A large percentage of students passed the exam.

a cunning or skillful act or scheme
He played a clever trick on his friend.

sound
The audio quality of the recording was excellent.

a graphic representation of data
The sales chart showed a steady increase over the last quarter.

the way in which something is arranged or presented
Please save the document in PDF format.

a break or opening in something
There was a small gap between the two fences.

physical injury or damage
The storm caused no serious harm to the building.

a house and its occupants regarded as a unit
Most households now have internet access.

the state of belonging to a group or organization
She applied for membership at the local gym.

a drop of clear salty liquid secreted from the eye
A single tear rolled down her cheek.

the air around the Earth; the mood of a place
The restaurant had a very relaxed atmosphere.

something accepted as true
He has a strong belief in justice.

equipment or clothing for a particular activity
We packed all our camping gear before the trip.

a track or set of tracks made of steel rails along which passenger and freight trains run
The old railway line is now used for walking.

a person who serves food or drinks; a computer program or device that provides a service to other computer programs or devices
The restaurant server was very polite.

a sudden upsetting or surprising event or experience
The news of his resignation came as a complete shock.

a person who approves of and encourages someone or something
She is a strong supporter of environmental protection.

a unit of weight equal to 2,000 pounds or 1,000 kilograms
He said he had a ton of work to do.

a person who votes or has the right to vote in an election
Every voter has the right to choose their representative.

a spiritual being acting as a messenger of God
The Christmas tree was topped with an angel.

an amount of money added to wages as a reward for good performance
The employees received a year-end bonus.

an organization set up to provide help and raise money for those in need
She donates regularly to a local charity.

the action or process of finding or learning something for the first time
The discovery of penicillin changed medicine forever.

a sudden brief burst of light
There was a flash of lightning during the storm.

a fortified building or strategic position
The soldiers built a fort to defend their position.

something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain
The disappearance of the ancient artifact remains a mystery.

the art or process of producing images by the action of radiant energy and especially light on a sensitive surface
She is studying photography at college.

rating
The movie received a high rating from critics.

temple
We visited an ancient temple during our trip.

trail
We followed the hiking trail through the forest.

arrival
We waited for their arrival at the airport.

concrete
The building's foundation is made of concrete.

explanation
Can you give me an explanation for this?

fiction
I prefer reading non-fiction to fiction.

muscle
Regular exercise helps build strong muscles.

strong emotion or enthusiasm
She has a great passion for music.

a series of actions conducted in a certain order
Follow the correct procedure for safety.

a person or company that makes or grows goods
The film producer announced the new project.

a person or thing that takes the place of another
We need a replacement for the broken part.

money kept for future use
She put her savings into a bank account.

a label attached to something
Read the price tag before buying.

a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers
She used a needle and thread to mend the shirt.

a fixed regular payment earned for work or services
He earns a good wage for his work.

a broad road in a town or city
They live on a tree-lined avenue.

a traditional and widely accepted way of behaving or doing something
It's a local custom to celebrate with a feast.

a small piece of paper, fabric, plastic, or similar material attached to an object
Read the label before washing the clothes.

a throw; a sales presentation; the quality of a sound
He made a great pitch to the investors.

the back part
The car was hit in the rear.

a thin strand of metal
Be careful, there's a loose wire sticking out.

a robot with a human appearance
Many new phones run on the Android operating system.

a strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility
He couldn't control his anger after the argument.

a formal religious or public occasion
The wedding ceremony was beautiful.

a person who makes people laugh; a comic book
He loves reading old comic books.

a police officer (informal)
The cop directed traffic at the intersection.
